title: Social-assistance case appointment letter
source: synthetic (fictional office; written for this project)
notes: Eastside Community Assistance Office is fictional. In demo mode its canned Spanish back-translation drops the date and time on purpose, to show the fidelity gauge falling and the desk stopping. Excluded from the trap-set on purpose: its canned interpretation is designed to fail, so scoring it would measure the demo data, not the desk.
summary_en: An appointment letter: see your caseworker on Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. at 700 Queen Street East, 2nd floor; bring photo ID and proof of rent; call (416) 555-0188 if you cannot attend.
text:
Eastside Community Assistance Office
700 Queen Street East, 2nd floor, Toronto, Ontario
September 4, 2026

Re: Your case appointment

Your appointment with your caseworker is on Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 10:30 a.m., at 700 Queen Street East, 2nd floor.

Please bring:
- photo identification
- proof of your rent (your lease or a rent receipt)

If you cannot attend, call (416) 555-0188 before the appointment to reschedule. Missing the appointment without notice may delay your assistance.

Eastside Community Assistance Office
